judgment.rationale: The issue combines last-known-zone placement for newly created windows with maximizing an existing window. Those are different lifecycle events; the app and expected restoration point are missing, so current behavior cannot yet be assessed as a defect.
evidence: Issue uses 0.99.1 and FancyZones “move newly created windows to their last known zone” setting.
Reporter says using maximize button does not remember window size.
No app name, restore/unmaximize behavior, comments, or linked fixes are provided.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for one application-specific sequence separating maximize/restore from launching a new window.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report does not identify whether the failure is last-zone placement on new windows or restore behavior for the maximized instance; no fix can be grounded until separated.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones reportedly does not remember a window’s previous zone/size after title-bar maximization.
known_information: Reporter prefers maximizing with title-bar button instead of dragging to top edge.
The setting specifically names newly created windows.
No comments or attached diagnostic are present.
inferences: May be an expectation mismatch between maximized state and restoring a newly created window.
issue_context.analysis: Clarify application and which window lifecycle should restore the saved zone.
initial_investigation: Read issue body; no comments or linked fixes.

information_gaps.information: The affected application and whether the maximized window is expected to return to its previous zone after restore/unmaximize, or to be re-zoned when newly launched.
information_gaps.why_needed: The setting concerns newly created windows, while report says maximizing an existing window via title-bar button does not remember its size. These are different lifecycle events.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On current release use one named app: zone it, maximize with title-bar button, unmaximize it, then launch a new instance and report which state is not remembered.

comment.body: Could you clarify the expected result with one affected application? Please zone and maximize its window with the title-bar button, then unmaximize it and say whether it returns to the zone. Separately, launch a new instance and say whether that new window is placed correctly by the “last known zone” option. This separates restore behavior from the feature’s new-window placement behavior.
